description: The single source of truth (SSOT) for quality scoring, Preview visual metrics, and thresholds, referenced by review roles as a human-readable scoring skeleton. After the refactor there is no longer a deterministic Python gate: critics/design-critic.md and critics/prototype-qa-reviewer.md are LLM self-check prompts for the review stage, and pass/fail is determined jointly by independent review verdicts, process/originality self-check, and real human approval, recorded in roles/review-templates/design-critique-report.md. During review, one must not set up separate scores or thresholds on one's own; the threshold numbers in SKILL.md §5 also follow this file.

authority.gate: host_llm + independent reviewers + real human approval
authority.note: Scoring dimensions and Preview visual thresholds are defined only once in this file; review roles reference this file as the scoring skeleton and must not set up separate scores or thresholds in the review documents.

gate.preview_blocking_rule: Any missing core renderSpec element, operable dataBinding, fallback, variant, component-specific state, exception/safety/stable-exit path, or responsive scenario is block; it must not be offset by coverage rate, total score, or name presence.
